canDoYue: 你識話自己唔舒服、講醫生紙、請人頂更，同埋話星期一返。
canDoEn: Say you are not feeling well, mention a doctor's note, ask someone to cover your shift, and say you will be back on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: Hello, I am calling in sick because I am not feeling well and I cannot start my shift.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我打電話請病假，因為我唔舒服，上唔到更。
dialogue.say: Hello, I am calling in sick because I am not feeling well and I cannot start my shift.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: I am sorry to hear that. Could you bring a doctor's note when you return?
dialogue.glossYue: 聽到你咁真係唔好意思。返嚟可唔可以帶醫生紙？
dialogue.say: I am sorry to hear that. Could you bring a doctor's note when you return?

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: Yes, I can bring the doctor's note that the clinic wrote for me this morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我可以帶診所今朝開嘅醫生紙。
dialogue.say: Yes, I can bring the doctor's note that the clinic wrote for me this morning.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: Who can cover your shift this morning?
dialogue.say: Who can cover your shift this morning?

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: Mei can cover my shift at the shop this morning while I stay home.
dialogue.glossYue: 今朝 Mei 可以喺舖頭頂我更，我留喺屋企。
dialogue.say: Mei can cover my shift at the shop this morning while I stay home.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: Will you be back on Monday, or will the doctor keep you at home longer?
dialogue.glossYue: 你星期一返，定係醫生要你喺屋企多留幾日？
dialogue.say: Will you be back on Monday, or will the doctor keep you at home longer?

dialogue.speaker: ines
dialogue.text: I will be back on Monday after the doctor clears me to start work again.
dialogue.glossYue: 醫生批准我開工，我就星期一返。
dialogue.say: I will be back on Monday after the doctor clears me to start work again.

dialogue.speaker: reid
dialogue.text: We will keep your Monday shift open at the front counter, and the team hopes you feel better.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋會留住你星期一櫃檯嘅更，團隊希望你快啲好返。
dialogue.say: We will keep your Monday shift open at the front counter, and the team hopes you feel better.
